text: It already bought back [$100M] of the debt on Nov 17.

sources: Trump Media 8-K / press release Nov 17 2026 (primary): repurchased $100M of 0.00% convertible senior secured notes due May 2028 below par with cash on hand; ~$883.5M outstanding; holders may require repurchase for cash on Nov 30 2026; interim CEO Kevin McGurn: use available cash and credit 'without issuing any additional equity'

CoinDesk (Nov 19, Shaurya Malwa): up to $883.5M could be demanded Nov 30; ~15,649 BTC at Sep 30 worth ~$1.31B then, ~$998M at $63,750; cash and short-term investments ~$393M at Sep 30; conversion price ~$34.72; filing warns it may need to sell bitcoin; 4,259 BTC moved Nov 5 (not a confirmed sale)
IBTimes / Benzinga (Nov 15): $1B convertible debt, Nov 30 deadline, conversion $34.72, 15,649 BTC
SCMP / Reuters: notes issued May 2025, holders can demand cash Nov 30; shares near record low $3.80
Yahoo Finance: DJT close $4.09 Nov 19 2026; BTC $61,835 (CoinGecko $61,733) Nov 20 07:45 UTC+8 -> 15,649 x ~$61.8K = ~$967M
